key_rationale: With headline CPI inflation at 7.01% persistently above the upper tolerance band and an output gap of +0.40%, a front-loaded policy action is necessary to prevent the unanchoring of inflation expectations. Given the systemic liquidity surplus of 190,000 crore INR, this 50 bps hike will enhance monetary transmission and align real interest rates with the objective of reining in core inflation, which remains elevated at 6.20%.
